bg_facts: Anthropic released Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 on Nov 9.

slides.title: What *happened*
slides.body: On November 9, Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2. It calls them its best models for long, open ended technical work. Both write answers up to 30% faster than the 5.1 versions.

slides.title: Fable vs *Mythos*
slides.body: They are the same underlying model. Fable 5.2 has cybersecurity and biology safeguards and is out now on paid Claude plans, Claude Code and the API. Mythos 5.2 has fewer limits and is only for vetted cybersecurity and life science teams.

slides.title: The *numbers*
slides.body: API price per million tokens fell 20%: $8 in and $40 out, down from $10 and $50. Opus 5.5 costs $4 and $20. A fast mode runs up to 2.5x quicker at double the price.

slides.title: On a *Pro plan*
slides.body: From Nov 9 to Nov 16, Fable is included on Pro for up to 50% of your weekly usage limit. After that week, Fable use bills to usage credits if you turn them on. The Free plan does not get these offers.

slides.title: What Anthropic *says*
slides.body: Start with Opus 5.5 for most coding and knowledge work. Move up to Fable for the hardest, biggest jobs. Step down to Sonnet or Haiku 5.5 when the task is simple and you want it cheaper.

slides.title: What it means *for you*
slides.body: Invoices, review replies and customer texts do not need the top model. Use Sonnet or Opus and save your limit. Try Fable this week on one big job, like a long contract summary. Always read the draft before you send.
